in_text_mentions: A total of 151 patients with melasma were enrolled in this study. After excluding those with incomplete data, 137 patients with valid data were included in the final analysis. The mean age of the participants was 38.13 ± 8.91 years. Based on dermoscopic findings, the patients were classified into four vascular types: the nonvascular change type (n = 17, Figures 1a and 2), the erythema type (n = 31, Figures 1b and 2), the strip‐ or branch‐shaped vascular type (n = 57, Figures 1c and 2), and the reticular vascular type (n = 32, Figures 1d and 2).
